summary: Obsidian Energy (TSX/NYSE: OBE) filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement add-on to its existing senior unsecured notes. The company will issue an additional $75 million aggregate principal of 8.125% notes due 2030 at a price of 102.75, with gross proceeds of $77.1 million. The notes rank equally with existing senior unsecured debt. Proceeds will repay credit facility borrowings, fund corporate expenses, and pay transaction costs. BMO Capital Markets and RBC Capital Markets are bookrunners. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
